summary: Hill County summit lookout cabin on the Rocky Boy's reservation; a 1957 USGS survey places its mark at the cabin. Listed as gone; no build date or site description found.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone with no date; no source we read describes what remains.

events.note: USGS survey description places the survey mark at the center of a lookout house on the summit

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com says 30 miles south of Havre; the 1957 USGS description says about 26 miles due south. Both are reported in the story; the sources are not reconciled.

notes_for_editor: Brief record matches sources: coordinates 48.18180, -109.68475 and Ground type. Brief has no agency; none found in cited sources. No build date, fate date or present-day description found; two web searches returned only location and reservation context. Quoted NGS datasheet (cite 2) is reproduced on the Forest Lookouts page. Distance from Havre differs between sources (26 vs 30 miles).
